{{Quote|Shuttle 593, this is Lothal Control. You are cleared to land.|[[Lothal Control]] to the crew of Shuttle 593|<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" />}}
'''Shuttle 593''' was a [[Star Commuter 2000]].<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" /> In [[4 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Senate Perspective]]" to [[4 BBY]].</ref> [[Senator]] [[Nadea Tural]] of the [[Imperial Senate]] boarded the shuttle on her way to the [[planet]] [[Arkanis]]. However, the [[hyperdrive]] malfunctioned, causing the Star Commuter to crash. The senator was then rescued by the members of the rebel [[Spectres|Spectre cell]].<ref name="SP">{{RebelsMagCite|9|Senate Perspective}}</ref> Later the same year,<ref name="Date 2">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Siege of Lothal]]'' to [[4 BBY]].</ref> the Spectres used the salvaged Shuttle 593 to make their way to [[Lothal]] without catching the attention of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Shuttle 593 first appeared in ''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Siege of Lothal]]''.<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" /> [[Martin Fisher]] confirmed that he intended the shuttle used by Nadea Tural in his short comic "[[Senate Perspective]]" to be same one.<ref name="S 593">{{Twitter|tronprogram2|status/784489080956588033|[[Martin Fisher]]|quote=@LelalMekha that was the idea as it would explain where the ship came from|archivedate=20230423025819}}</ref>
